content: Řeḥkamat Yahuda d Israil u x timmura i d asent-i-dd innḍen

Awařen n Ɛamus, wenni tuɣa iǧan jar imeksawen n Taquɛa, awařen i iẓra x Israil, deg wussan n Ɛuzziya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, d Yarubɛam, mmis n Yuwac, ajeǧid n Israil, tnayen n iseggʷusa qbeř i wenhezzi n temmurt.
Netta inna: “SIDI ad izehhar zi Ṣihyun, ad issgeɛɛed tmijja nnes zi Urcalim. Ddmani n tarewsa ad ceḍnent u taqiccet n Karmil ad tisřaw.”
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI: X třata n ixeṭṭan i igga Dimacq, ɛad mahu x arebɛa, war t ssbeṭṭařeɣ, minzi nitni ssarwaten Jilɛad s teřwiḥin itteḥřuǧuḍen n wuzzař i usarwet.
Ad ssekkeɣ timessi di taddart n Ḥazayil, ad tecc řeqṣur n Binhadad.
Ad arẓeɣ zzekrun n Dimacq u ad mḥiɣ wenni izeddɣen zi Buqɛa-Awan, zi řewḍa n wareddeǧ, d wenni zi taddart n meẓri i yarebbun azeǧaḍ, u řgens n Aram ad ittwandeh di tmeḥbast ɣar Qir!, inna SIDI.”
“Ammu i inna SIDI: X třata n ixeṭṭan i igga Ɣazza, ɛad mahu x arebɛa, war t ssbeṭṭařeɣ, minzi nitni iwyen řgens inu qaɛ di lmenfa, ḥima ad t sellmen i Idum.
Ad ssekkeɣ timessi daxeř di řeḥyuḍ n Ɣazza, ad tecc řeqṣur nnes.
Necc ad teḥḥiɣ amezduɣ zi Acdud u zi Acqalun wenni yarebbun azeǧaḍ u Necc ad ksiɣ afus inu ḍidd i Ɛaqrun u min iqqimen n ayt n Ifilisṭiniyyen ad ittwahellek, iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI.”
“Ammu i inna SIDI: X třata n ixeṭṭan i igga Ṣur, ɛad mahu x arebɛa, war t ssbeṭṭařeɣ, minzi nitni sellmen řgens inu qaɛ di lmenfa i Idum, war idaren řɛahd ak-d wawmaten nsen.
S uyenni ad ssekkeɣ timessi daxeř di řeḥyuḍ n Ṣur, ad tecc řeqṣur nnes.”

“Ammu i inna SIDI: X třata n ixeṭṭan i igga Idum, ɛad mahu x arebɛa, war t ssbeṭṭařeɣ, minzi netta iḍfar awmaten nnes s ssif u issɛiǧi arreḥmet nnes, u minzi aɣḍab nnes iqqim icarreg břa qeṭṭu, u minzi aheddi n uduqqez nnes n ufugem iqqim issaggwad řebda.
Necc ad ssekkeɣ timessi di Tayman, ad tecc řeqṣur n Buṣra.”
“Ammu i inna SIDI: X třata n ixeṭṭan i iggin ayt n Ɛammun, ɛad mahu x arebɛa, war t ssbeṭṭařeɣ, minzi nitni carrgen timɣarin s ddeyset zi Jilɛad, ḥima ad sswessɛen tammurt nsen.
Necc ad ssarɣeɣ ict n tmessi daxeř i řeḥyuḍ n Rabba, ad tecc řeqṣur nnes, ɣar iɣuyyan deg wass n umenɣi, am isuḍ usemmiḍ deg wass n tḥaryaḍt.
Ajeǧid nsen ad yuyur di lmenfa, netta ak-d řḥukkam nnes, inna SIDI.”
